dedupe_keys.name: u s soilgrids 100 m soil property maps

description: U.S. SoilGrids+ publishes predictions of soil properties and taxonomic classes across the contiguous United States at 100 m grid resolution. It combines national soil observations, soil polygons and remote-sensing layers through random forest and gradient-boosting models. The named dataset includes organic carbon, nitrogen, bulk density, pH, sand and clay, plus class probabilities at seven reported depths from 0 to 200 cm. The resource is a spatial snapshot, not a regularly updated time series. Its GitHub page names a separate DOI for map access and states Open Database License 1.0 terms. The DOI metadata resolves to a ScholarSphere item, although that landing page returned HTTP 403 to this review environment. A limitation is that prediction accuracy varies by property and location; the README reports classification accuracy of 60% for soil great groups and 66% for texture classes. Preliminary magnesium, potassium and conductivity maps are explicitly unvalidated. These maps can prepare ground and land-cover assumptions for water, foundation and hazard simulations. They support flood and land-surface model inputs, while local site investigations remain necessary for engineering design. The catalogue's global ISRIC SoilGrids product is a related but different dataset.
